defects: nonneg hypothesis is stated over the closed ray Ici N instead of gold's open ray Ioi N (mathematically redundant given antitone + nonneg just above N, but textually a different hypothesis)
integrable hypothesis is stated over Ici N instead of gold's Ioi N (equivalent since {N} has measure zero and f is measurable by antitonicity, but not a literal match)

conclusion is stated as Summable (fun n => f (N + n)) instead of gold's Summable (fun n => f n) — an index-shifted version of the same claim, equivalent via summable_nat_add_iff but not the same expression
